messages:
sarah: Quick intake for Ember-20B — we ran a first-pass eval, some quant experiments, and need to coordinate catalog entry + docs + a soft announcement. TL;DR: quality looks on-par with baseline; 4-bit QAT shows small PPL bump but latency/cost wins.

sanjay: Can you drop the quick results here? want to see latency numbers and which quant configs were used.

sarah: Sure — pasted below. Small table from local bench (A100s), batch=1, seq=2048.

```
Model           | FP16 PPL | 4-bit QAT PPL | tokens/sec (FP16) | tokens/sec (4-bit)
Ember-20B-raw   | 12.4     | 13.1          | 320               | 610
Ember-20B-pruned| 12.8     | 13.6          | 350               | 690
```

sarah: Notes: quality delta ~= +0.7 PPL with 4-bit QAT (within our acceptable regression threshold of 1.0 for this workload). Cost per token approx -45% on 4-bit in our model-cost simulator.

eva: Nice. Which eval sets did you run? any hallucination/regression hits on our customer prompts?

sarah: Ran MMLU-lite, 10k sample from internal prompt-bank (support+search+summaries). MMLU a hair lower (0.6%), but on conversational summarization we saw 2-3% ROUGE drop for edge cases with long context (>6k tokens) — likely kv-cache handling in quant path.

mike: kv-cache issue noted in other 4-bit runs. Can we reproduce with a minimal failing prompt? would help eng-runtime.

sarah: Added an example to the thread: "Summarize the following 7k-token meeting transcript focusing on action items." Runtime returns repeated segments in 4-bit at around step 1800.

sanjay: I'll triage with eng-runtime tomorrow. For rollout plan we should gate on: 1) regen tests for top 300 prompts, 2) perf SLOs satisfied, 3) docs + catalog entry ready, 4) announcement copy.

olga: I can own the catalog entry + docs. Will need the model metadata (training data blurb, license, recommended quant profiles, default max_seq_len). Put my checklist here: 
- model id
- short description
- architecture + params
- recommended variants (fp16, 4-bit-q, pruned)
- perf numbers (latency/cost)
- quality caveats
- sample prompts + eval artifacts

sarah: Model metadata (first draft):
```
model_id: ember-20b-v1
arch: transformer decoder only
params: 20B
pretrain_data: mixed web + code + docs (proprietary blended, see legal)
license: permissive-cc-like (TBD with legal)
max_seq_len: 8192
recommended_variants: [fp16, 4bit-qat, pruned-8g]
notes: 4-bit-qat recommended for cost-sensitive endpoints; watch long-context summarization regressions
```

sarah: Also attaching eval artifact links (in a follow-up message from the eval bot).

qa-bot: Automated test run finished: regen-suite (300 prompts) -> 295 passed, 5 flagged (all for long-context summaries). See /artifacts/ember-20b/regen-1791234567.json

olga: Good to know. I'll include that in the catalog "known_issues" section.

mike: For the quant experiments, what quantization backend did you use? bitsandbytes 4-bit with QAT or gptq?

sarah: Used QAT with custom calibration on our infra (similar to 4bit-qat-v2). I put the exact command here:

```
python quantize.py --model ember-20b --method qat --calib-file calib.json --out ember-20b-4bit-qat
```

sanjay: Runtime: please add e2e test to the model-serving testbed to reproduce the repeated segments. Tagging @mike to follow up.

mike: On it. I'll spin a dedicated run and try disabling KV-cache fold optimizations to isolate. ETA EOD tomorrow.

olga: Announcement plan (soft): Draft a short internal announcement for the console release + a small note in the model catalog UI. Proposed copy: "Ember-20B now available in catalog — cost-optimized 4-bit variant available with recommended QA gating for long-context summarization. Reach out to #eng-ml for onboarding."

eva: Add a note about SLAs / not production-ready for regulated customers until legal signs off.

sarah: Owners:
- eng-ml triage & final go/no-go: @sanjay
- runtime fix & perf verification: @mike
- catalog + docs + known_issues: @olga
- regen QA signoff: @eva
- announcement + onboarding playbook: @sarah

sanjay: Timeline proposal:
- T+1d: runtime triage + reproduce (mike)
- T+2d: regen rerun after fixes (qa-bot)
- T+3d: docs + catalog entry final (olga)
- T+4d: soft internal rollout + console flag (deploy-bot will post)

deploy-bot: Scheduled flag rollout: ember-20b-v1 -> internal-console -> 2026-03-23T15:00Z (can be canceled)

mike: I found the kv-cache edge repro locally. Disabling the fold optimization avoids repetition at 4-bit but increases latency 8%. I'll open a PR with a conditional runtime flag to toggle the optimization per-model.

sanjay: Sounds good — we'll include that as a per-model runtime config in the catalog: "kv_cache_fold_opt: recommended_on|fallback_off_for_4bit_longctx"

olga: Drafted the catalog entry skeleton and pushed to docs repo branch ember-20b-catalog. I'll link when ready.

sarah: I'll prepare the internal announcement once olga confirms PR merged and regen pass is green. Thank you all. :rocket:

eva: Adding one final ask: let's capture a short eval note comparing Ember-20B -> Baseline-18B to show cost delta + quality tradeoffs for PM folks.

sarah: Will do — will paste a 1-paragraph summary in the announcement (and attach the detailed artifact).

mike: PR opened: runtime/kv-fix (#4821). cc @sanjay @sarah

sanjay: Marking this thread as the single source for the Ember-20B bring-up. If you need ownership changes ping here.

olga: Catalog PR: docs/models/ember-20b.md created, awaiting review.

qa-bot: Regen re-run: 300/300 passed after kv-fix. artifact: /artifacts/ember-20b/regen-1791234789.json

sarah: Great — proceeding to schedule the soft rollout and internal announce. Will post the announcement copy here for quick sign-off before sending.

mike: :thumbsup:

olga: :pray:

sanjay: Approved to announce once olga + eva confirm docs & QA.
